basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Canada with a passion for gaming, particularly Path of Exile. I frequently dabble in 3D printing, creating intricate terrain pieces for tabletop games. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings, usually after finishing my homework. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends online, discussing physics and sharing tips on managing Hashimoto's. I dislike being labeled and prefer a laid-back approach to life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in physics and engineering, which I explore through my school courses and self-learning projects. I also have hands-on experience with 3D printing, a skill I've honed over the past year. My gaming knowledge is extensive, especially in action RPGs like Path of Exile.
